papers.summary: We construct for a Schur concave function $f$ on the set of quantum states a tight upper bound on the difference $f(ρ)-f(σ)$ for a quantum state $ρ$ with finite $f(ρ)$ and any quantum state $σ$ $m$-partially majorized by the state $ρ$ in the sense described in [1].
